LOW-CHASE FROM ROAD — camera flush against sun-baked hardpan as the rig thunders past at full roar, rear axle dominating upper frame, welded rebar cage and lashed fuel-drums visible, massive dust-cloud boiling low across cracked earth behind spinning rear wheels.

OVER-THE-BONNET POV — camera bolted to the spike-ram prow looking forward, a welded-chain hood-ornament swaying in lower foreground, cracked salt-flat highway stretching ahead with a fleeing buggy at vanishing point, the rig's exhaust stacks belching black smoke either side.

AERIAL DRONE FOLLOW — overhead shot tracking from above-right at low altitude, the rig's scrap-patchwork roof-armor reading below, a braided dust-trail extending far behind across a dead salt lake, shadow of the rig sharp and small against the pale cracked ground.

PARALLEL-RUN-WITH-RIG — camera car matching speed alongside the driver's side, two crew leaning from roof-hatches firing sawn-off weapons at off-frame pursuers, welded license-plate side-armor in sharp detail, ground beneath a blur of speed and loose gravel spray.

DRIVER-OUT-WINDOW — driver half-hanging from the cab window mid-drive, cracked goggles and rag-wrapped face, one fist white-knuckled on the steering wheel, scrap-armor plating inches from their shoulder, wasteland streaking past in hard motion-blur behind their head.

GUNNER-ON-ROOF POV — eye-level from the roof-gunner position, a welded-pipe heavy-gun barrel dominant in lower frame, brass casings raining sideways in wind, the rig's antenna-pole forest visible at left edge, dust-haze and a distant pursuer closing below.

REAR-OF-RIG ASCENDING — camera mounted at rear-corner of the rig looking back, four pursuit-buggies closing fast through the billowing dust, roof-gunner firing downward with an improvised chain-gun, spent shells pinging off the rear ramp, smoke swallowing the gap between.

CRASHED-VS-RUNNING WIDE — wide wasteland shot, burning pursuer wreck silhouetted black in deep foreground with smoke rising, hero rig running hard in midground trailing dust, scrap-fin rear-spines reading clearly, distant mesa skyline completing a scene of total wreckage and flight.

TOTEM-ANTENNA FOREGROUND — the rig's towering war-banner pole rises in extreme left foreground hung with bone-trophies and chain-wrapped skulls, rig body extending rightward behind it, crew clinging to the rear deck railing, antenna-spines bending as the rig accelerates across open flats.

GANG OF RIGS CONVOY — wide low-angle shot across cracked hardpan, five mismatched scrap-rigs running in loose arrow formation, hero rig leading at center-frame, individual dust-trails braiding and merging behind, each vehicle showing its own bush-fix patchwork of oil-drums, rebar, and stripped bodywork.

CHASING-LEAD POV — handheld-feel POV from inside a pursuing cab, hero rig ahead obscured by its own exhaust and dust, pursuing gunner's spike-tipped weapon barrel creeping into lower-right frame, the gap closing yard by yard over broken salt-flat road.

PIT-CREW MID-REPAIR — rig stopped hard in a gulch, four crew swarming over it: one welding a cracked frame rail with sparks flying, one hand-cranking a fuel-drum transfer pump, one hammering a spike-plate back on with a rebar mallet, dust-storm wall rolling in behind.

JUMP-MID-AIR — rig fully airborne off a shale-ridge ramp, all four wheels clear of ground, the entire undercarriage and welded cross-brace skeleton visible beneath, crew gripping interior cage-bars, loose chain-armor swinging free, landing strip of shattered earth visible below in motion.

DUSK-SILHOUETTE WIDE — hero rig edge-lit amber-orange against a vast burning sunset, antenna-spines and rear-deck totem reading as pure black silhouette, massive dust-trail rolling low across the lower frame, sky filling two-thirds of the shot in theatrical fire-and-smoke color.

NIGHT-FIRE-LIT — total darkness around the rig, crew lit only by a roaring fire-barrel lashed to the rear deck and the orange wash of a forward torch-array, silhouetted figures clinging to the sides, wasteland beyond swallowed by blackness as the rig roars onward.

WHIRLWIND CIRCLE — camera spinning slowly around the rig at mid-height as a dust-devil tears through it, crew bent double shielding faces, antenna-poles whipping in arcs, loose chain-armor streaming horizontal, the rig's welded-scrap body visible through veils of fast-streaming sand and grit.

GUN-MOUNT REVERSE POV — camera sitting at rear of the rig looking forward across the flat deck, the welded rotating gun-mount and its braced gunner dominant in mid-frame, driver's helmet and cab-frame visible far forward, wasteland horizon rushing toward the rig between them.

WIDE-VALLEY APPROACH — high-vantage shot from a canyon lip looking down, hero rig descending a switchback scree-slope into a massive salvage-yard valley, wrecked car-carcasses and rusted derricks scattered below, smoke columns rising from multiple fire-pits, the rig tiny and purposeful at the entry point.

CHASE-RAM IMPACT — frozen-motion frame of two rigs colliding hard, spike-plates from the pursuer locking into the hero rig's flank armor, debris and shredded sheet-metal exploding outward, both crews jolting forward, dust and grit erupting in a halo around the point of impact.

SUNSET-OVER-THE-FLATS — extreme wide shot at ground level, hero rig a tiny crawling shape in deep center distance, its dust-trail the single largest element in the frame stretching horizon-wide behind it, sky above burning in layered bands of rust-red and sulfur-yellow.

HOOD-SCOOP CLOSE PURSUIT — camera bolted just above the air-intake hood-scoop at bonnet-center, the scooped metal and welded bead dominant in sharp foreground, a pursuing rig looming large ahead-behind reflected in a cracked wing-mirror, exhaust heat shimmering above the engine cover.

BELLY-PASS UNDERCARRIAGE — camera at ground-level looking straight up as the rig passes directly overhead, full undercarriage exposed: welded cross-members, lashed suspension chains, cracked differential housing, spinning driveshaft, all visible for one thundering second as the chassis passes and dust closes after it.

CREW-CLING SIDE-SWIPE — tight shot from alongside the rig at shoulder height, a crewmember hanging off welded exterior handholds one-handed as the rig scrapes past a wrecked car-hulk, sparks and torn metal spraying between the two frames, their boot barely clearing the wreck's door-post.

SMOKE-STACK ASCENDING — camera starting low at exhaust-pipe level and tilting steeply upward as twin stacks belch thick black smoke skyward, the smoke column becoming the dominant vertical element, rig body receding below, a second pursuing rig visible through the smoke-haze in the upper frame.

FUEL-DRUM ROLL-LOSS — mid-chase rear-angle shot as a lashed fuel-drum breaks free from the rig's flank-rack, bouncing and tumbling across the road directly toward the nearest pursuer, the pursuer swerving hard, the hero rig's rear armor reading in detail as it pulls away through the dust.
